# Tech Compensation Negotiation Skill for Muse

Negotiate tech compensation end-to-end for product and engineering roles, built from insights across Lenny's Podcast and Newsletter. It benchmarks your value against standardized job levels (with US PM salary tables by level and percentile), teaches intelligence gathering during interviews (ask for the budgeted band — never give your number first), provides exact deflection scripts for the salary-expectations question, and walks you to evaluate startup equity like an investor (strike price, total outstanding shares). Core principles: negotiate over the phone, not email; maximize base salary since it amplifies bonuses and future raises; match your ask to the company's philosophy (high-cash like Netflix vs high-equity like Google). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: all salary data is US tech and PM-centric — and drawn from podcast posts that will age; outside US product/engineering roles, treat the benchmarks as directional, not literal. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
